title: Animal Welfare Project - Fodder
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Elegant undertook an animal welfare initiative by donating fodder for animals.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Elegant undertook an animal welfare initiative by donating fodder for animals. This thoughtful gesture aimed to ensure the availability of nutritious food for animals and support their well-being. The initiative reflects Rotary’s compassion towards all living beings and its commitment to serving the community.
